mapper.select: select schedule_id as scheduleId, emp_no as empNo, branch_code as branchCode, work_date as workDate, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, is_repeat as isRepeat, repeat_group_id as repeatGroupId, memo, work_type as workType from branch_schedule where schedule_id=#{value}
select emp_no as empNo, branch_code as branchCode, name, position_code as positionCode, status from employee where branch_code = #{value} and status = 'ACTIVE' order by name

select s.schedule_id as scheduleId, s.emp_no as empNo, e.name as empName, s.branch_code as branchCode, b.name as branchName, s.work_date as workDate, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, s.is_repeat as isRepeat, s.repeat_group_id as repeatGroupId, s.memo, s.work_type as workType from branch_schedule s left join employee e on s.emp_no = e.emp_no left join branch b on s.branch_code = b.branch_code
and e.emp_no like CONCAT('%', #{empNo}, '%')
and e.name like CONCAT('%', #{empName}, '%')
and s.branch_code = #{branchCode}
and b.name like CONCAT('%', #{branchName}, '%')
and s.work_date = #{workDate}
order by s.work_date DESC, s.start_time ASC
mapper.update: update branch_schedule set start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, is_repeat=#{isRepeat}, repeat_group_id=#{repearGroupId}, memo = #{memo}, work_type = #{workType} where schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
